description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to evidence from files you select and index in Axiomyx Personal. Search your evidence, retrieve relevant passages, and check their source provenance. Access is read-only: this plugin does not modify your source files or run commands. Axiomyx Personal must be installed, running, online, and connected. You approve the connection in the desktop app. Your index remains on your computer; requested evidence is transmitted through an authenticated relay to the AI service you connect.

defaultPrompt: Show the evidence sources currently available in my Axiomyx library.
Find my evidence about a topic, cite the exact sources, and say whether the search was truncated.
Check the provenance and content hash of the Axiomyx evidence used in your last answer.
